assumptions: Integrator repair attempt 3. In this round the integrator wrote only .orchestration/contracts/README.md, .orchestration/contracts/validate.py, .orchestration/evidence/F02/validate-all.log and this handoff. Every other contract file was written by the three F02 lanes. In their repair attempt 3 the data lane changed its files for A6D2-01 and A6D2-02, the math lane changed its files for F02-MATH2-P2-1, P3-2 and P3-3, and the offers lane changed nothing. CX-29 in validate-all.log shows that every sha256 recorded in the three lane logs still matches the current bytes.

artifacts lists every file under .orchestration/contracts/ (407 files) and every file under .orchestration/evidence/F02/data, math and offers (24 files), with sha256 computed after the last write. It excludes the A6 review folders (a6-design-attempt1 and 2, a6-math-attempt1 and 2), which A6 wrote, and the stray evidence/F02/math/__pycache__/ file, which a lane run left behind.

validate-all.log is deliberately not listed in artifacts. Section E, the F02-HANDOFF-CHECK run of this very file, is appended to it after this handoff is written, so a hash taken before that append would be stale. It is referenced as test evidence instead.

F02-NEGATIVE-CONTROL exits 1 by design. validate.py ran on a scratch copy of contracts/ with three injected defects: already_booked removed from E05, one .why.txt deleted, and 'assets' removed from the data model's PB-SCAN-1 list. It reported exactly those defects (S3, CX-05 and the XL-17 regression check) plus the resulting data-lane log drift (CX-29). The in-harness negative controls NC-1 to NC-14 all pass.

Index-owned findings of reviews/F02-design-attempt2.md addressed here. A6D2-04: validate.py translates every schema pattern to ECMA-262 semantics, and S2 checks that all 93 translate; NC-13 shows that a trailing newline in resource_id or occurred_at is now rejected while plain jsonschema accepts it. A6D2-09: README section 2a gains an activation gate column, derived from the approval-scopes.md section 2 baseline (A6, G2, G6) plus the production gates of each row's capabilities, plus G5 for WF11. The WF11 row now cites operational-data-model.md section 5 for retention. CX-31 now checks section citations, rule IDs and activation gates, and NC-14 proves each check catches a defect.

One new cross-lane item, XL-20 (P3): operational-data-model.md bookings.offer_id holds offer-matrix meeting-type IDs (intro-15, book-consultation-30), and book-consultation-30 is not an offer ID. It is tracked as KNOWN. Sixteen items are open (section 5.1), all P3. Four stay resolved and regression-checked (section 5.2): XL-01, XL-09, XL-11 and XL-17.

Review findings that still reproduce inside a single lane are listed for the verifier in README section 5.3 and not fixed here. Data lane: A6D2-03, A6D2-06, A6D2-07, A6D2-08 and A6D-08 to A6D-11. Offers lane: A6D2-05, A6D-14 and A6D-15. Math lane: attempt-2 P3-1, the two display-rounding faults that no fixture pins. The math lane deferred P3-1 because README row 14 names WM01-WM36. README now states that adding a fixture that follows the existing rules is allowed under section 3 rule 6, and that the integrator updates row 14 and CX-21 in the same round.
The integrator re-read the lanes' repair-3 closures (A6D2-01, A6D2-02, F02-MATH2-P2-1, math P3-2 and P3-3) and lists them in README section 5.3 as closed by the lanes. A6 still has to re-verify them.

README section 3 rule 8 is proposed for A0 confirmation: lane repairs inside F02's own review cycle (attempts 2 and 3) kept version 1.0, because no task has been dispatched against 1.0 and no approval is bound to an earlier hash. Once A0 records acceptance, every contract edit bumps the version.
Frozen-for-build is not an approval. Every contract still says proposed, and no G0-G6 record exists. F02 stays submitted until A6 verifies it and A0 records acceptance.

The venv at the scratchpad path (Python 3.11.15, jsonschema 4.26.0) is session scratch space; README section 7 gives the commands to recreate it. No package other than jsonschema and its dependencies is used. The lane validators were re-run read-only: a sha256 over contracts/ and the three lane evidence folders is identical before and after (validate-all.log section C).
